title: Extract unique URLs from text
source: Apple ships a native Shortcuts action 'Get URLs from Input' that returns any links found in text; pulling links out of text is a recurring, first-party-supported Shortcuts need (also Automators forum requests). https://matthewcassinelli.com/actions/get-urls-from-input/
signature: function extractUrls(text)  // text: string -> string[] (unique URLs, first-seen order)
prompt: Write a JavaScript function `extractUrls(text)` that finds all web URLs in the text. A URL is a run of non-whitespace characters beginning with 'http://' or 'https://'. Return the URLs de-duplicated, in the order they first appear. Return an empty array if there are none.

args: Mixed http://x.io and https://y.io and http://x.io again
